Name: ProtectFlooring
Author: Stitch1959
Description:
[b]OVERVIEW[/b]
The game deletes a floor tile whenever a weed spreads onto it overnight, and a pickaxe, axe or bomb removes it instantly. Paths you laid out carefully disappear while you sleep. This mod stops all of that.

[b]WHAT IT DOES[/b]
• Blocks flooring removal by pickaxe, axe and explosions, each one can be switched off separately.
• Block every damage source, a master switch for players who want zero risk.
• Release keybind, default LeftControl or clicking the left stick, so you can still remove a floor on purpose.
• Overnight protection, when the weed spread would delete a floor, the original flooring object is put back, so the variant, colour and any mod data stay intact.
• Optional protection for empty tilled soil and for tilled soil with crops.
• Optional cleanup of debris that lands on protected tiles, plus a daily sweep.
• Optional suppression of the false "weeds destroyed your crops" notice when nothing was actually lost.

[b]SETTINGS[/b]
Install Generic Mod Config Menu to change any of these in game.

• Tools and explosions, pickaxe, axe, explosives, the master switch and the release keybind.
• Overnight weeds, protect paths, protect empty tilled soil, protect crops, remove debris.
• Feedback, blocked sound, blocked hint, hide the false notice, daily summary, verbose log.
[b]
COMPATIBILITY[/b]
• Supersedes ProtectFlooring 2.x and the separate SafeFlooring mod. Do not install those alongside it.
• Works in every location, not only the farm.
• No custom save data is stored, so you can remove the mod at any time.
• Languages, English, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish and Simplified Chinese.

REQUIREMENTS
• SMAPI 4.0.0 or later, tested with 4.5.2, game version 1.6.15.
• Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.
